cards.text: We're back at Mount Sinai, and the first stone tablets didn't make it. Moses broke them. So the LORD tells Moses to chisel out two new stone tablets like the originals, and friend, I know a thing or two about getting a second chance.

cards.question: Moses does the chiseling. Then the LORD says He will do the ___ on the new tablets Himself.

cards.text: Then the LORD sets the meeting: "Be ready in the morning, and come up on Mount Sinai to present yourself before Me on the mountaintop." A MORNING meeting on top of a MOUNTAIN, and I'd still be down at the bottom looking for my hat.

cards.question: This time, Moses gets to bring a few helpers up the mountain with him.
No one may be seen anywhere on the mountain. How far does the LORD take that rule?

answers.text: Not even flocks may graze in front of it
Only the elders may wait halfway up
Aaron may stand guard at the bottom

cards.text: So Moses chisels out the tablets, gets up early, and carries two STONE tablets up Mount Sinai, just as the LORD commanded. I carry ONE cookie box up the bakery steps and have to sit down and rethink my whole life.

cards.question: Moses is up on Mount Sinai. How does the LORD come down to meet him?

cards.text: The LORD stands there with Moses and proclaims His name, the LORD. Then He passes in front of Moses and calls out who He is.

cards.question: The LORD calls Himself compassionate and gracious. So how quickly does He get angry?

answers.text: He is never angry at all

cards.question: The LORD says He keeps up His loving devotion to a thousand generations.

cards.text: He forgives iniquity, transgression and sin. But He's not done describing Himself yet.

cards.question: The LORD says He will leave the guilty unpunished.

cards.text: Instead, the LORD says He "will visit the iniquity of the fathers on their children and grandchildren to the third and fourth generations."
Moses immediately bows down to the ground and worships. No warm-up, no "hold on one sec," just DOWN.

cards.question: Still bowed down, Moses asks the Lord for something. What does he ask?

answers.text: Go with us and forgive us
Send an angel ahead of us
Give us a king to lead us

cards.question: Even while asking for forgiveness, Moses is honest about the people. He calls them a ___-necked people.

cards.text: The LORD answers Moses: "Behold, I am making a covenant." And He promises wonders that have never been done in any nation in all the world.

cards.question: All the people Israel lives among will see the LORD's ___, because it is an awesome thing He is doing.

cards.text: Now the terms: "Observe what I command you this day." The LORD will drive out six nations before them, the Amorites, Canaanites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites, and meanwhile I can't win a fight with one stubborn oven door.

cards.question: Once they enter the land, the LORD wants Israel to make treaties with the people living there.
Why does the LORD warn Israel against a treaty with the people of the land?
So what is Israel supposed to do with the altars, sacred stones and Asherah poles in the land?

answers.text: Use them all for the LORD

cards.question: The LORD makes His reason plain. Israel must not worship any other ___.

cards.text: Then He tells them about His name. The LORD, "whose name is Jealous, is a jealous God."

cards.question: The LORD warns that if Israel makes a covenant with the people of the land, those people will invite them to eat their sacrifices.

cards.text: It goes further. If Israel's sons take their daughters as brides, the LORD says, "their daughters will prostitute themselves to their gods and cause your sons to do the same."

cards.question: Next comes a short command about molten gods. What does the LORD say about them?

cards.text: Then come rules for Israel's year: the Feast of Unleavened Bread, the Feast of Weeks, the Feast of Ingathering, the firstborn that belong to the LORD, and three times a year to appear before Him. There's even a seventh day of rest during plowing and harvest season, which is like me still taking my day off in the busiest week of the year.
Then the LORD tells Moses, "Write down these words, for in accordance with these words I have made a covenant with you and with Israel."

cards.question: How long is Moses up on the mountain with the LORD this time?
During that time up on the mountain, Moses eats bread and drinks water.

cards.text: Forty days with no bread and no water, and I get cranky when the oven runs five minutes late. And now the tablets hold the words of the covenant, the Ten Commandments.
Moses comes down from Mount Sinai with the two tablets of the Testimony in his hands. But something about him has changed from speaking with the LORD.

cards.question: From speaking with the LORD, Moses' ___ has become radiant.
Moses knows his face is radiant as he comes down the mountain.

cards.text: Aaron and all the Israelites look at Moses, and behold, his face is radiant. Meanwhile Moses is strolling in like it's a regular Tuesday, glowing like my oven light with NO idea.

cards.question: How do Aaron and the Israelites react to Moses' radiant face?

answers.text: They are afraid to come near him
They run out to welcome him
They bow down and worship him

cards.question: The people are keeping their distance from Moses. What does Moses do?

answers.text: He hides in the Tent of Meeting
He goes back up the mountain

cards.text: Aaron and all the leaders of the congregation come back to him, and Moses talks with them.

cards.question: After the leaders, all the Israelites come near to Moses too.
With all the Israelites gathered around, what does Moses do?

answers.text: He gives them all the LORD told him
He sends them back to their tents
He tells them to wait for Aaron

cards.text: When Moses finishes speaking with them, he puts a veil over his face.

cards.question: Whenever Moses goes in before the LORD to speak with Him, what does he do with the veil?

answers.text: He takes it off until he comes out
He keeps it on the whole time
He hands it to Aaron to hold

cards.text: When he comes out, Moses tells the Israelites what he was commanded, and they see that his face is radiant. Every single time, like the light that pops on when I open the oven door.

cards.question: Then Moses puts the ___ back over his face until he goes in to speak with the LORD again.

findings.problem: Moses is the first person to appear in the lesson, but the card never says who he is.

rule.text: New people. The first time someone shows up, he says simply who they are, like "Cyrus, king of Persia" or "Moses, Israel's leader."

findings.problem: Aaron appears in a story card for the first time with no word on who he is. His only earlier mention was in a wrong answer (stop 1, card 5).

rule.text: New people. The first time someone shows up, he says simply who they are, like "Cyrus, king of Persia" or "Moses, Israel's leader."

findings.problem: The question says no one may be seen anywhere on the mountain. That rules out both wrong answers (elders waiting halfway up, Aaron standing guard), so only the right answer fits.

rule.text: A setup line can't rule out the wrong answers either.

findings.problem: "The LORD calls Himself compassionate and gracious. So how quickly does He get angry?" The word "So" makes slow to anger sound like a result of compassion. Exodus 34:6 only lists the qualities side by side.

rule.text: Leave open what the text leaves open. Who is being spoken to, why, or how two things connect.

findings.problem: Moses' request to "take us as Your inheritance" (Exodus 34:9) is never told on any card. The right answer covers only "go with us" and "forgive us," so the baker misses part of his prayer.

rule.text: When the baker leaves Prep, they understand the whole passage without missing an important detail.

findings.problem: The right answer "He gives them all the LORD told him" softens the text. Exodus 34:32 says Moses "commanded them to do everything that the LORD had told him."

rule.text: Call things what the text calls them.
